currentEvidenceSummary.knownStageLabelCaveat: Description-derived skillDamage formulas must be compared to SIO trace skillDamage as a standalone factor, not collapsed into local en2 vulnerability labels.

decisionPolicy.initialDecision: No direct first-party description-derived formula rows are present, so SIO formula correctness cannot be confirmed or rejected from descriptions yet.
decisionPolicy.observedDamageValidationRole: Observed damage validation is secondary confirmation for description-vs-SIO divergences, not the first validation layer.
decisionPolicy.userFacingClaimLimit: Tangtang may claim SIO Tools-equivalent source/live backing only; it must not claim description-derived official formula verification.

derivationSchema.divergencePolicy: A description-derived divergence does not immediately change Tangtang scoring; it opens a targeted confirmation task and correction spec.
derivationSchema.promotionPolicy: Only direct first-party item/effect description captures parsed into formula operations may increment directFirstPartyDescriptionFormulaRows.
